coverage_gap: No real mixed-organ/platform sample is present in this first set; mixed handling is tested with fictional unit cases only.

Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Fresh frozen lung tissues were embedded in OCT, and 10 µm frozen sections were cut with cryostat

sequencing libraries were generated using 10X Genomics Visium Spatial Gene Expression Slides & Reagent kit according to manufacturer's protocol. cDNA samples were amplified and purified using SPRIselect reagent to isolate optimal cDNA peaks (250-600 bp)
Sample_data_processing: Tissue alignment was independently performed to manually select tissue areas using Loupe browser v6.1.0. Sequencing output (Fastq files), alignment json file, and H&E images were processed on Spaceranger v1.3.1 to align the reads with reference genome (GRCh38-2020-A), and to generate count matrix.

Tissue alignment was independently performed to manually select tissue areas using Loupe browser v6.1.0. Sequencing output (Fastq files), alignment json file, and H&E images were processed on Spaceranger v1.3.1 to align the reads with reference genome (GRCh38-2020-A), and to generate count matrix.

Count matrix that contains only barcodes associated with tissue areas were used for downstream analysis. Spatial output including tissue positions were loaded in Loupe Browser v9.0.0 to manually annotate spots corresponding to airway, vessel, and areas outside as parenchyma.
The Spaceranger output (gene matrix and tissue image) was loaded as a Seurat object in the R environment and all analysis steps performed in R (v4.4.1)

Data were subjected to quality control by assessing number of unique genes detected, number of UMI counts, and percentage of mitochondrial RNA. Spots with low library size (<100-150), expressed fewer than 100-150 genes, and contain more than 20% mitochondrial transcripts were excluded. To generate biologically relevant information, we subset the feature genes to retain only the protein coding genes identified from EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86 package
Assembly: GRCh38-2020-A

Sample_data_processing: Transcript-based niche embedding files (node_meta.csv and .npy files) were genetared using GraphSAGE.
Information about output files can be found here:
https://www.10xgenomics.com/support/in-situ-gene-expression/documentation/steps/onboard-analysis/understanding-xenium-outputs

Sample_title: Primary limited-stage small cell lung cancer FFPE tissue 1
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: tissue preparation protocol: FFPE tissue blocks were sectioned at 5 μm thickness and mounted onto Xenium slides. Tissue sections were baked, deparaffinized, decrosslinked, and processed according to the 10x Genomics Xenium In Situ protocol. Sections were hybridized with probes from the Xenium Human Pan Tissue & Pathways 5K panel, followed by probe ligation, rolling circle amplification, fluorescent labeling, and staining with DAPI, ATP1A1, E-cadherin, and CD45 prior to imaging.
Sample_description: Surgically resected primary limited-stage small cell lung cancer FFPE specimen profiled using the Xenium In Situ platform.
Sample_data_processing: Xenium output files were generated using Xenium Ranger.

Sample_title: Human right ventricle Xenium, capture region 0038213_Region1
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: tissue preparation protocol: 5-um sections of FFPE right ventricular tissue were mounted onto Xenium slides (10x Genomics) and processed per the manufacturer's protocol (CG000578) using the Xenium Slides and Sample Prep Reagents kit (PN-1000460), comprising deparaffinization, decrosslinking, fixation and permeabilization. Nine RV samples (3 NF, 3 pRV, 3 RVF) were selected on RNA quality and sample geometry (typically 10 x 10 mm).
Sample_description: 3 transmural RV section(s) from patient(s) 1697, 1691, 1618 imaged in a single capture region (154,475 cells). Per-cell section assignment, spatial coordinates and cell-type labels are in 0038213_Region1_cells_stats.csv. Counts are the 477-gene measured panel after Proseg resegmentation; SpaGE-imputed genes are not included. Two matrices are provided: 0038213_Region1_cell_feature_matrix.h5 holds the raw measured counts (all cells), and 0038213_Region1_ambient_corrected_matrix.h5 holds the same cells after ambient-RNA correction and QC filtering (non-integer values; this is the matrix analysed in Figure 3).
Sample_data_processing: Cells were resegmented with Proseg. Cell types were assigned by RCTD against the matched snRNA-seq reference with SPLIT correction. Ambient RNA was removed to produce the corrected matrices; those counts are non-integer. Deposited count matrices contain the 477 measured panel genes only - SpaGE-imputed genes used elsewhere in the study are excluded.

Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Frozen tissue (30 mg) from LAM lungs was minced and lysed in buffer, then filtered. Nuclei were sorted using Sony SH800 and 150,000 nuclei were collected. Nuclei were spun and resuspended and concentrations adjusted for 10X multiome: 11,000 nuclei were loaded to target recovery of 7,000 nuclei. Fresh tissue from LAM44 was minced lysed in buffer yielding 300,000 nuclei. Nuclei were washed and resuspended. Final nuclei (11,000) were loaded for 10X.
Library was constructed by following 10X protocol: Chromium Next GEM Single Cell Multiome ATAC+ Gene Expression User Guide (CG000338).
Sample_data_processing: Demultiplexed data was processed using the 10X Cell Ranger count pipeline
Further processing was done with Seurat v4.1.0 (cell and gene filtering, hashtag identification, clustering, differential gene expression analysis).
Assembly: GRCh38
